comment:
* This is the Stack abstraction for the active object that waits for messages * to appear on the wire and processes these messages by calling the * MessageFactory interface to create a ServerRequest or ServerResponse object. * The main job of the message processor is to instantiate message channels for * the given transport. * * @version 1.2 $Revision: 1.18 $ $Date: 2009/10/16 22:58:41 $ * * @author M. Ranganathan
*

variables.name: IN_ADDR_ANY
variables.comment: * A string containing the 0.0.0.0 IPv4 ANY address.

variables.name: IN6_ADDR_ANY
variables.comment: * A string containing the ::0 IPv6 ANY address.

variables.name: sentBy
variables.comment: * My Sent by string ( which I use to set the outgoing via header)

variables.name: ipAddress
variables.comment: * The IP address where I am listening.

variables.name: port
variables.comment: * The port where I am listening

variables.name: transport
variables.comment: * The transport where I am listening

variables.name: listeningPoint
variables.comment: * The Listening Point to which I am assigned.

methods.name: public final void initialize(InetAddress ipAddress, int port, SIPTransactionStack transactionStack)
methods.comment:
* Initializes this MessageProcessor. Needed for extensions
     * that use classloading
     * 
     * @param ipAddress2
     * @param transactionStack
     * @param port2

methods.name: public String getTransport()
methods.comment:
* Get the transport string.
     *
     * @return A string that indicates the transport. (i.e. "tcp" or "udp")

methods.name: public int getPort()
methods.comment:
* Get the port identifier.
     *
     * @return the port for this message processor. This is where you receive
     *         messages.

methods.name: public Via getViaHeader()
methods.comment:
* Get the Via header to assign for this message processor. The topmost via
     * header of the outoging messages use this.
     *
     * @return the ViaHeader to be used by the messages sent via this message processor.

methods.name: public String getSavedIpAddress()
methods.comment: * Get the saved IP Address.

methods.name: public InetAddress getIpAddress()
methods.comment: * @return the ip address for this message processor.

methods.name: protected void setIpAddress(InetAddress ipAddress)
methods.comment: * @param ipAddress the ipAddress to set

methods.name: public void setSentBy(String sentBy) throws ParseException
methods.comment:
* Set the sentby string. This is used for stamping outgoing messages sent
     * from this listening point.
     *
     * @param sentBy

methods.name: public String getSentBy()
methods.comment:
* Get the sentby string.
     *

methods.name: public abstract SIPTransactionStack getSIPStack()
methods.comment:
* Get the SIP Stack.
     *
     * @return the sip stack.

methods.name: public abstract MessageChannel createMessageChannel(HostPort targetHostPort) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Create a message channel for the specified host/port.
     *
     * @return New MessageChannel for this processor.

methods.name: public abstract MessageChannel createMessageChannel(InetAddress targetHost, int port) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Create a message channel for the specified host/port.
     *
     * @return New MessageChannel for this processor.

methods.name: public abstract void start() throws IOException
methods.comment: * Start our thread.

methods.name: public abstract void stop()
methods.comment: * Stop method.

methods.name: public abstract int getDefaultTargetPort()
methods.comment: * Default target port used by this processor. This is 5060 for TCP / UDP

methods.name: public abstract boolean isSecure()
methods.comment: * Flags whether this processor is secure or not.

methods.name: public abstract int getMaximumMessageSize()
methods.comment: * Maximum number of bytes that this processor can handle.

methods.name: public abstract boolean inUse()
methods.comment:
* Return true if there are pending messages to be processed (which prevents
     * the message channel from being closed).

methods.name: public abstract void run()
methods.comment: * Run method.

methods.name: public boolean isSentBySet()
methods.comment: * @return Returns the sentBySet.
